technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term overbought RSI9 and MACD crossover bullish, but weak trend strength (ADX 22.78), divergent momentum (AO negative), and SMA positioning concerns limit confidence for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AMCR shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 48 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (17/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction (small sales by junior members) and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (369.28), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 48 days adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI9 overbought with bullish rising + MACD bullish crossover + extreme fear sentiment (17/100) creates contrarian entry opportunity near support (52.79) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment in crisis (VIX 369.28, recession yield curve, rising USD), weak trend strength (ADX 22.78), negative momentum divergence (AO), zero fundamental conviction, and earnings binary risk in 48 days overwhelm technical setup.
